messages.subject: Installing RHIPE and Machine Learning Algorithms
parts:
Hello Everyone,

I am a novice with RHIPE and have very little experience with Hadoop so please forgive me if I sound ignorant. I had a few questions regarding the installation of RHIPE.

1. Does R need to be installed on the edge node? I noticed R can be zipped and transferred to each data node to avoid installing R on each data node.
2. Are the Google Protocol Buffers required to be installed on each node or is it sufficient to be installed on only the edge node.


Also, I was wondering, are there any "out of the box" machine learning algorithms that would work in RHIPE (similar to something like Mahout)? I am interested in a distributed linear regression algorithm in particular. If so, would it be possible for someone to point me in the direction of some documentation (or perhaps a tutorial). Thank you all for your help. I really appreciate it.

Regards,
Mike
